messages:
sam: Heads-up — we need to lock a time for the cross-func sprint sync next week. Need RFC review + design review + priority triage. Can people share availability?

maya: I can do Tue/Wed morning PT. Agenda: 15m roadmap + 20m RFC deep-dive (Payment routing), 10m open triage.

alex: Tue morning is OK but we have oncall rotation — prefer Wed 10am PT. Who's owning the RFC pre-read?

maya: I'll upload the RFC draft by EOD today. @alex can you skim before Wed?

alex: Yep will skim. Ping me if urgent.

lia: Design review depends on updated mock for checkout flow — expecting to post by tomorrow noon.

jordan: Infra note: we need 10m to discuss rollout safeguards for Dedicated test cluster (can be quick). Wed 10am PT works for infra.

sam: Sounds like Wed 10am PT is leaning. I'll run a quick Doodle but want to avoid extra polls. Can folks add these blocks: Wed 10-11 PT, Tue 9-10 PT, Thu 8-9 PT.

maya: added Wed 10. Also propose agenda owners: maya - roadmap, alex - RFC, lia - design, jordan - infra rollout, sam - triage/decisions.

alex: happy to own RFC. Can we get pre-read link? maybe paste in thread.

maya: Pre-read: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/payment-routing-draft v0.3 — comments open. TL;DR: fallback routing + cache key changes.

lia: mock link: https://figma.com/file/checkout-flow — will add notes in comments.

sam: Quick ask: if someone can't make Wed, please drop async notes using this template:

`- Decision needed:`
`- Tradeoffs:`
`- My vote:`
`- Blockers:`

I'll compile before meeting.

alex: One more — can we limit sync to 45m? Cutting to 45 will keep it sharp.

maya: +1 to 45m. Move design deep-dive to a follow-up if needed.

jordan: Also add deploy-bot note: scheduled maintenance Wed 9:30-10:00 PT — might affect infra folks. @sam pls confirm.

sam: Good catch. I'll check with infra ops and propose Wed 10:15 if maintenance blocks 10:00. Back in 30.

sam: Update — ops says maintenance ends 10:05. We'll keep 10:15 start to be safe. Revised blocks: Wed 10:15-11:00 PT. Please update calendars.

maya: Updated. Posting agenda doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/meetings/sprint-sync-030 - will add timeboxes.

alex: ACK. I'll drop any pre-review comments by EOD.

lia: I'll mark design follow-up slot and add prototypes.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar event created for Wed 10:15 PT — invite sent to participants.

sam: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD, consider time and agenda locked. :raised_hands:
